name: pluto
description: Use TalentPluto's live recruiting workflows, privacy-filtered candidate discovery, bulk candidate work-email enrichment, LinkedIn profile enrichment, candidate-to-team connection matching, candidate-to-Team-DNA alignment scoring, TalentPluto-managed or connected-inbox outbound campaigns, and privacy-thresholded market snapshots through a stable, authenticated Pluto connection.

interface.shortDescription: Use TalentPluto recruiting, outbound, and market tools.
interface.longDescription: Connect once to use TalentPluto's live recruiting, candidate-email enrichment, LinkedIn profile enrichment, candidate-to-team connection matching, candidate-to-Team-DNA alignment scoring, reviewable TalentPluto-managed or connected-inbox outbound campaigns, confirmed campaign cancellation, and market-insight workflows in Codex. Pluto advertises its current tools and input contracts from its MCP server, and consequential actions require explicit user direction.
defaultPrompt: Use Pluto to help with this recruiting task.
Find AI engineers with 1+ years of professional experience in New York.
Find people who match this pasted job description.
Give me a directional US market snapshot for engineering talent.
How many Pluto credits do I have left, and when do they reset?
Ask whether the selected in-network candidate's recorded preference is compatible with a $180,000 annual base salary.
Get and verify the available emails for the candidates I selected.
Get the full public profiles for the LinkedIn profile URLs I supplied.
Who on my team has the strongest connection to the candidate LinkedIn profile URL I supplied?
Assess the candidates I selected against our engineering team's Team DNA.

Create a campaign for the out-of-network candidates I selected. Prefill the basics, let me choose whether to write exact shared copy, provide generation instructions, or have Pluto draft the emails for me, then show the complete editable sequence and ask me to confirm the final review.
Cancel my outbound campaign for the payments role.
Continue with the candidate and role I selected in Pluto.
